decisions.reason: As a publicly introduced extension tightly tied to the core practice software and the firm's paperless digital-practice direction, management would likely continue to justify and support it absent clear evidence of persistent failure.

Although newer and less visibly committed than some other launches, this module builds directly on the installed software base and would likely be retained while management attributes any early weakness to normal ramp-up effects.

Because secure healthcare messaging is strategically central to regulation-driven digital integration and was prominently presented in the firm's update communication, management would be strongly inclined to keep it and view any initial problems as temporary.
